description: SYNTHETIC test set for the contradiction detector only. Each 'original' is a claim quoted verbatim from the corpus; each 'planted' sentence was written for this test. 'contradiction' pairs should be flagged, 'consistent' pairs (paraphrases) should not. Not used as ground truth for any QA metric.
